NewsArticle.title: NewsArticle
NewsArticle.description: A scraped crime or incident news article from a Bangladeshi news portal.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this database record.

summary.description: Cleaned summary or excerpt of the news report.

url.description: Canonical URL of the news report.

portalName.description: Display name of the Bangladeshi news portal.

portalDomain.description: Domain name of the news portal.

category.description: Primary crime or incident classification category (built-in or user-defined).

matchedKeywords.description: Comma-separated keywords matched inside the article.

district.description: Detected district or division in Bangladesh.

publishedDate.description: Publication date in YYYY-MM-DD format for date range filtering.

verificationStatus.description: Review state of the scraped article; archived is terminal.

isBookmarked.description: Whether the article is bookmarked for priority review.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the article was stored.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the article was last modified.

KeywordConfig.title: KeywordConfig
KeywordConfig.description: User-customizable keyword search configuration and auto-scrape settings for a crime category.

ownerId.description: UID of the authenticated user who owns this configuration.

category.description: Crime or incident category identifier (built-in or user-defined).

keywordsCsv.description: Comma-separated Bengali/English keywords used for scraping this category.

autoSyncEnabled.description: Whether automatic periodic scraping is active for this category.

syncIntervalMinutes.description: Interval in minutes between automatic background scrapes.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the configuration was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the configuration was last updated.

/news_articles/{articleId}.description: Stores scraped Bangladeshi crime and incident news articles indexed by date and category.

/keyword_configs/{configId}.description: Stores user-defined keyword lists and auto-update preferences per crime category.
